entities.summary: Juliana Felisberta da Silva is a Brazilian female beach volleyball player who won the silver medal in the women's beach team competition at the 2005 Beach Volleyball World Championships in Berlin, Germany and the 2009 Beach Volleyball World Championships in Stavanger, Norway, partnering with Larissa França. At the 2011 Beach Volleyball World Championships, they won the gold medal. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, they won the bronze medal.
